chunks: My father narrated to us, may God be pleased with him, saying: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated to us, from his father, from Al-Hasan ibn Abi Al-Husayn Al-Farsi, from Suleiman ibn Hafs Al-Basri, from Abdullah ibn Al-Husayn ibn Zayd ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib, from his father, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon them).

He said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Four characteristics will never cease in my nation until the Day of Resurrection: taking pride in lineage, challenging/questioning lineages, relying on astrology for rain, and loud mourning. And indeed, the mourner (woman) who does not repent before her death will stand on the Day of Resurrection wearing a shirt of tar and an armor of scabies.'

key_terms.دِرْعٌ مِنْ جَرَبٍ: An armor of scabies/itchy skin disease

ai.seo_question: What are the four characteristics that will remain in the Muslim nation until the Day of Judgment according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq presents these four traits as persistent social and spiritual ailments, linking pre-Islamic Jahiliyyah customs like genealogical pride and astrological divination to their enduring presence in the community. The specific punishment for the unrepentant mourner—garbed in tar and scabies—serves as a vivid eschatological metaphor for the internal corruption of loud, wailing grief (al-naykhah) that characterizes the pre-Islamic era.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 4-60 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim quoted his father, on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn (Abil) Hussein al-Farsi, on the authority of Suleiman ibn Hafs al-Basry, on the authority of Abdullah ibn al-Hussein ibn Zayd ibn al-Hussein ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib, on the authority of his father Zayd ibn Ali, on the authority of his father Ali ibn al-Hussein (MGB), on the authority of his father (MGB), on the authority of Ja’far ibn Muhammad as-Sadiq (MGB), on the authority of his forefathers (MGB), on the authority of Ali (MGB)

that God’s Prophet (MGB) said, “Four characteristics will never vanish in my nation until the Resurrection Day: taking pride in their ancestry; challenging the lineage; relying on astrology; and mourning aloud over the dead. If a woman who mourns aloud dies without having repented, she shall be resurrected with a shirt made of tar and an itchy armor.”
